"""Every number and every open ruling in Playmaker lives here.

Numbers come straight from the rulebook, the trackers and the scenario rules.
Settings marked OQ-n match the numbered items in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md: each default
is the one the designer asked for, and a ruling is a one-line change here.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace

# ---- fixed numbers from the rules ------------------------------------------
BOARD_COLS = 17            # A..Q
BOARD_ROWS = 14            # 1..14, row 1 is the baseline
RIM = (8, 2)               # I2
TOKENS_PER_PHASE = 6
PHASE_SECONDS = 2
START_CLOCK = 12
DIE = 20                   # d20
FAR_CONTEST_PENALTY = 3    # defender further from the rim than the shooter
TURNOVER_POINTS = -5
STEAL_FOUL_BONUS = 5       # first foul on a steal
FT_MULT_TWO = 2
FT_MULT_THREE = 3
MAX_ACTIONS_PER_TURN = 2
MOVE_STRAIGHT = 3          # up to 3 straight
MOVE_DIAGONAL = 2          # up to 2 diagonal
INBOUND_PHASES = 2
SCENARIO_GOAL = 30         # an Excellent look

# Per-phase limits. 'move' is once per player; the rest are per side.
LIMITS = {
    'O': {'qs': 2, 'pass': 2, 'screen': 2, 'dribble': 2, 'hesitate': 1, 'shot': 1},
    'X': {'qs': 2, 'intercept': 2, 'challenge': 2, 'steal': 2, 'pause': 1},
}
TURN_ENDERS = {'pass', 'screen', 'dribble', 'hesitate', 'shot',
               'intercept', 'challenge', 'steal', 'pause'}

# Prestige bands, highest first: (name, lowest score in band)
BANDS = [('Excellent', 30), ('Great', 25), ('Good', 20), ('Okay', 15), ('Poor', None)]
# Coach's Call bonus by band of the look
COACH_BONUS = {'Poor': 0, 'Okay': 2, 'Good': 5, 'Great': 8, 'Excellent': 10}

# Zone -> allowed shot types and points
ZONE_SHOTS = {
    'K': ('layup', 'dunk', 'post'),
    'M': ('mid', 'floater'),
    'L': ('long',),
    '3': ('three',),
    '.': (),
}
ZONE_POINTS = {'K': 2, 'M': 2, 'L': 2, '3': 3}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rules:
    # OQ-1: ball after an intercept or steal that plays on.
    #   'play_on' : ball back to the passer / stays with the carrier, -5, play continues.
    #   'end'     : the possession ends at that point.
    turnover_play_on: str = 'play_on'
    # OQ-2: when a pass resolves.
    #   'defence_turn' : on the defence's next turn (it may Intercept); if it doesn't,
    #                    the pass completes at the start of that turn.
    #   'immediate'    : completes at once unless a defender is already on the line.
    pass_resolution: str = 'defence_turn'
    # OQ-3: Sprint length = Move length + Quick Step, in one straight line.
    sprint_orth_base: int = MOVE_STRAIGHT
    sprint_diag_base: int = MOVE_DIAGONAL
    # OQ-4: roll bounds. A target >= 20 always succeeds, <= 0 always fails.
    natural_rolls: bool = False
    # OQ-5 (ruled): a declared shot worth less than 0 scores 0, matching the forced shot.
    floor_declared_shot: bool = True
    # OQ-6: defence reaction to a declared shot may use 0, 1 or 2 actions (movement, arrow
    #   turns, Steal) from the tokens still in the pool.
    reaction_kinds: tuple = ('move', 'qs', 'sprint', 'steal')
    reaction_may_decline: bool = True
    # OQ-7: defence out of tokens ends the phase at once (as written).
    defence_empty_ends_phase: bool = True
    # OQ-8: a wait (Hesitate / Pause) may not be played on the turn straight after the
    #   other side's wait.
    wait_chain_block: bool = True
    # OQ-9: screen geometry.
    #   'from_t_or_corner' : a defender's diagonal step is banned if it starts on the T
    #                        square or cuts the T square's corner (T is one of the two
    #                        squares the diagonal passes between).
    #   'from_t_only'      : only diagonal steps that start on the T square are banned.
    screen_rule: str = 'from_t_or_corner'
    # OQ-10: arrow line. A ball carrier move is illegal only if its path goes from one
    #   side of the ray to the other (touching or stepping onto the line is fine).
    arrow_line_strict: bool = True
    # OQ-11: a 1 straight + 1 diagonal Move may go in either order.
    move_either_order: bool = True
    # OQ-12 (ruled: the defence chooses any adjacent defender): contest choice.
    #   'min_value' : defence picks the adjacent defender (or none) that minimises the
    #                 expected shot value, counting foul free throws.
    #   'nearest'   : the nearest adjacent defender (rulebook wording), ties by min value.
    #   'player'    : (RULED, step 3b) the defence chooses: contest with any adjacent defender, or not.
    contest_choice: str = 'player'
    # ---- new questions found while building (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 13+) ----
    # OQ-13: a square is 'on the pass line' if its centre lies within this distance of
    #   the segment (0.5 = the line goes through the middle half of the square;
    #   0 = exact centre, as check_scenarios.py does).
    on_line_tolerance: float = 0.5
    # OQ-14: Quick Step may be shorter than the card value (up to 2, not exactly 2).
    qs_up_to: bool = True
    # OQ-15: a player with Quick Step 0 cannot Sprint.
    sprint_needs_qs: bool = True
    # OQ-16 (ruled): who may Challenge a screen.
    #   'on_t'     : only the defender standing on the screen's T square (the one it blocks).
    #   'adjacent' : any defender next to the screener.   'any' : any defender.
    challenge_who: str = 'on_t'
    # OQ-17 (ruled): a locked ball carrier may not Dribble: a lost dribble means pass or shoot.
    locked_can_dribble: bool = False
    # OQ-18: a Dribble win frees the carrier from that defender's arrow line for the rest
    #   of the phase.
    dribble_win_lasts: str = 'phase'
    # OQ-19: before the inbound pass lands the inbounder may only Pass.
    inbounder_pass_only: bool = True
    # OQ-20 (ruled): the far-contest -3 never takes a contest below 0.
    floor_contest_zero: bool = True
    # OQ-21: a side with tokens but no legal action forfeits its remaining tokens.
    forfeit_when_stuck: bool = True
    # OQ-22: Need a Three: a two-point shot (and its free throws) scores 0.
    three_only_ft_on_twos: bool = False
    # OQ-23: Coach's Call bonus uses the band of the look (shot value, or free throws if fouled)
    #   and also applies to a forced shot by the target.
    coach_bonus_on_forced: bool = True
    # OQ-24: the arrow-line restriction applies to defenders adjacent at the start of the
    #   movement action.
    arrow_line_adjacent_at: str = 'start'
    # OQ-25: two diagonal steps of a Move go the same way (a straight diagonal line).
    diag_move_straight: bool = True
    # OQ-27 (ruled): on a failed inbound, a tie for "furthest from the rim" is the offence's
    #   choice ('offence'); 'lowest' gives the ball to the lowest piece number.
    inbound_tie: str = 'offence'
    # OQ-30 (RULED, step 3b): the forced shot's type at clock 0. 'player' = the offence picks among the
    #   types its zone allows; 'best' = the engine picks the best expected value.
    forced_shot_choice: str = 'player'
    # OQ-35 (ruled): an inbound pass works like any other pass. The defence gets its normal
    #   turn (1 or 2 actions: e.g. Move then Intercept, Sprint then Intercept, or move two
    #   players); the pass resolves after that turn, then the phase resets to the card's clock.
    #   'after_defence_turn' (ruled) | 'defence_turn_start' (step 1: lands at the start of the turn)
    inbound_resolves: str = 'after_defence_turn'
    # OQ-34 (new rule, the and-one): once a shot is declared (or forced at clock 0), any foul
    #   scores the higher of the free throws and the shot's uncontested value. Fouling a good
    #   look can then never help the defence. False = free throws only.
    and_one: bool = True


DEFAULT_RULES = Rules()


def with_rules(**changes):
    """A copy of the default rules with some settings changed."""
    return replace(DEFAULT_RULES, **changes)

"""Replay a playtest log, and show where the solver disagreed with each human decision.

The solver's values are estimates from a short search, so a gap is "where the solver disagreed",
not a mistake.
"""
import json

from .actions import Action
from .resolve import apply, ChanceNode, force
from .scenarios import scenario_state, game_state

TABLE_O = ['I11', 'C9', 'O9', 'A3', 'Q3']
TABLE_X = ['I10', 'D8', 'N8', 'G4', 'N4']
TABLE_ARROWS = ['N', 'NE', 'NW', 'N', 'N']


def read(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]


def _action(d):
    dest = d.get('dest')
    return Action(d['kind'], d['side'], int(d.get('piece', -1)), tuple(dest) if dest is not None else None,
                  int(d.get('arrow', -1)), int(d.get('target', -1)), d.get('shot', '') or '')


def _start(setup, possession, o_sq=TABLE_O, x_sq=TABLE_X, arrows=TABLE_ARROWS, ball=0):
    if setup.get('scenario'):
        return scenario_state(setup['scenario'])
    off, dfn = setup['teams'] if possession == 1 else setup['teams'][::-1]
    return game_state(off, dfn, list(o_sq), list(x_sq), list(arrows), ball=ball)


def replay(records, on_decision=None):
    """Rebuild every state from the log. Rolls are replayed from the logged outcomes.
    Returns a list of (possession, final state)."""
    setup = next(r for r in records if r['type'] == 'setup')
    possession = 1
    state = _start(setup, 1)
    finals = []
    undo = []                         # states before each action since the last roll (as the server keeps)
    placed_o = None
    i = 0
    while i < len(records):
        r = records[i]
        if r['type'] == 'placement':
            if r['side'] == 'O':
                placed_o = (r['squares'], r['ball'])
            else:
                state = _start(setup, possession, placed_o[0], r['squares'], r['arrows'], placed_o[1])
                if r.get('start') and state.encode() != r['start']:
                    raise ValueError('placement replay diverged')
        elif r['type'] == 'possession':
            finals.append((possession, state))
            possession = r['possession']
            state = _start(setup, possession)
            undo = []
        elif r['type'] == 'undo':
            state = undo.pop()
            if state.encode() != r['state']:
                raise ValueError('undo replay diverged')
        elif r['type'] == 'action':
            a = _action(r['action'])
            if on_decision and r.get('actor') == 'human':
                on_decision(state, a, r)
            before = state
            node = apply(state, a)
            j = i + 1
            rolled = isinstance(node, ChanceNode)
            while isinstance(node, ChanceNode) and j < len(records) and records[j]['type'] == 'roll':
                node = force(node, records[j]['picked'])
                j += 1
            if isinstance(node, ChanceNode):
                raise ValueError(f'log is missing a roll after {a}')
            undo = [] if rolled else undo + [before]
            state = node
            i = j - 1
            if state.encode() != r['after']:
                raise ValueError(f'replay diverged after {a}: {state.encode()} != {r["after"]}')
        i += 1
    finals.append((possession, state))
    return finals


def review(path, budget_s=5.0, out=print):
    """Print each human decision with the solver's preferred action and the gap in value."""
    from .solver import Searcher, apply_play, expected
    from .solver_config import with_config
    cfg = with_config(eval_turns=1)
    rows = []

    def decide(state, a, rec):
        if a.kind in ('target', 'pick', 'end_turn') and state.stage != 'reaction':
            return
        se = Searcher(cfg)
        res = se.search(state, budget_s=budget_s)
        e = res['entry']
        if e is None or not e.children:
            return
        maximise = state.side == 'O' and state.stage != 'reaction'
        best_p, best_v = (max if maximise else min)(e.children, key=lambda pv: pv[1][0].ev)
        chosen = [v for p, v in e.children if p.actions[0] == a]
        if chosen:
            cv = chosen[0][0].ev
        else:
            node = apply(state, a)
            cv = expected(node, se.ev)[0].ev
        gap = (best_v[0].ev - cv) if maximise else (cv - best_v[0].ev)
        rows.append(dict(possession=rec.get('possession'), clock=rec.get('clock'), side=state.side,
                         played=str(a), solver=best_p.text(), gap=round(gap, 2)))

    replay(read(path), decide)
    out(f'Review of {path} ({len(rows)} human decisions; solver at {budget_s:g} s per position).')
    out('Where the solver disagreed (its values are estimates, not verdicts):')
    for r in rows:
        mark = '' if r['gap'] <= 0.5 else f'   <- solver preferred: {r["solver"]} (+{r["gap"]:.1f} for the {"offence" if r["side"] == "O" else "defence"})'
        out(f'  poss {r["possession"]} clock {r["clock"]:>2} {r["side"]}: {r["played"]}{mark}')
    return rows


# ---- post-game review helpers (step 3c) -------------------------------------------------------------

def replay_states(records):
    """Every decision state in the log, in order, with the action taken there."""
    out = []

    def grab(state, a, rec):
        out.append((state, a, rec))
    _replay_all(records, grab)
    return out


def _replay_all(records, fn):
    """Like replay(), but calls fn at every action (human and computer)."""
    orig = [dict(r) for r in records]
    for r in orig:
        if r['type'] == 'action':
            r['actor'] = 'human'
    replay(orig, on_decision=fn)


def board_advantages(records, k=3):
    """The biggest matchup advantages the board offered: a ▲ shooter's shot value against the contester
    eligible at that moment (an adjacent defender, the one giving the lowest value; none = contest 0),
    over every decision point. Returns the top k (distinct player, square and shot type), and whether
    the possession's shot used any of them."""
    from . import board as B
    from . import rules_config as RC
    from .scoring import contest_rating
    best = {}
    finals = []
    for state, a, rec in replay_states(records):
        if state.stage not in ('play', 'reaction'):
            continue
        for i, p in enumerate(state.o):
            if not B.on_board(p):
                continue
            z = B.zone(p)
            for t in RC.ZONE_SHOTS[z]:
                card = state.ctx.off[i]
                if card.bands['shot_' + t] != 'H':
                    continue
                pts = RC.ZONE_POINTS[z]
                opts = [(0, None)]
                for j, xp in enumerate(state.x):
                    if B.adjacent(xp, p):
                        opts.append((contest_rating(state.ctx.dfn[j], t, xp, p, state.ctx.rules), j))
                c, j = max(opts, key=lambda o: o[0])
                v = pts * (card.shot(t) - c)
                key = (rec.get('possession', 1), i, B.sq(p), t)
                if key not in best or v > best[key]['value']:
                    best[key] = dict(possession=key[0], o=i + 1, square=key[2], shot=t, rating=card.shot(t),
                                     contest=c, contester=(j + 1) if j is not None else None, value=v,
                                     clock=state.clock, phase=state.phase,
                                     text=f'O{i + 1} {t} {card.shot(t)}▲ on {key[2]} v '
                                          + (f'X{j + 1} contest {c}' if j is not None else 'no eligible contester')
                                          + f': {pts} × ({card.shot(t)} − {c}) = {v}')
    top = sorted(best.values(), key=lambda b: (-b['value'], b['o']))[:k]
    shots = [r for r in records if r['type'] == 'end']
    taken = []
    for r in records:
        if r['type'] == 'action' and r['action']['kind'] in ('shot', 'forced_shot'):
            taken.append((r.get('possession', 1), r['action']['piece'] + 1, r['action']['shot']))
    for b in top:
        b['used'] = (b['possession'], b['o'], b['shot']) in taken
    return top


def solver_disagreements(path_or_records, budget_s=1.0, k=3, max_decisions=12):
    """Key moments where the solver's preferred action differed most in value (estimates)."""
    import tempfile, os, json as _json
    recs = path_or_records if isinstance(path_or_records, list) else read(path_or_records)
    humans = [r for r in recs if r['type'] == 'action' and r.get('actor') == 'human']
    if len(humans) > max_decisions:              # keep the review quick: the first decisions of each side
        keep = set(id(r) for r in humans[:max_decisions])
        recs = [r if r['type'] != 'action' or r.get('actor') != 'human' or id(r) in keep else dict(r, actor='skip')
                for r in recs]
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.jsonl', delete=False) as f:
        for r in recs:
            f.write(_json.dumps(r) + '\n')
        path = f.name
    try:
        rows = review(path, budget_s, out=lambda *a: None)
    finally:
        os.remove(path)
    rows = [r for r in rows if r['gap'] > 0.5]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r['gap'])
    return [dict(r, label='estimate') for r in rows[:k]]

"""Scout reports from the card data and the range table only (no solver, no position).

The report describes; it never instructs. Every strength is a ▲ value and every liability a ▼ value
on the card (the bands come from the locked range table), so it says nothing the card does not.
"""
from .cards import TEAMS

MARK = {'H': '▲', 'A': '', 'L': '▼'}

# One phrase per rating and band. ▲ = above average, ▼ = below average (fouls: lower is better, and
# the card's band already says which way is good).
PHRASES = {
    'dribble': ('strong ball-handler', 'below-average ball-handler'),
    'pass': ('strong passer', 'below-average passer'),
    'screen': ('strong screener', 'below-average screener'),
    'shot_layup': ('strong finisher at the rim', 'below-average finisher at the rim'),
    'shot_dunk': ('strong dunker', 'below-average dunker'),
    'shot_post': ('strong post scorer', 'below-average post scorer'),
    'shot_floater': ('strong floater', 'below-average floater'),
    'shot_mid': ('strong mid-range shooter', 'below-average mid-range shooter'),
    'shot_long': ('strong long-two shooter', 'below-average long-two shooter'),
    'shot_three': ('strong three-point shooter', 'below-average three-point shooter'),
    'free_throw': ('strong at the line', 'below average at the line'),
    'agility': ('quick on-ball defender', 'below-average on-ball defender'),
    'intercept': ('reads passing lanes well', 'below average at reading passing lanes'),
    'challenge': ('strong at fighting through screens', 'below average at fighting through screens'),
    'steal': ('active hands', 'few steals'),
    'foul_steal': ('rarely fouls on steals', 'fouls easily on steals'),
    'con_layup': ('strong layup contest', 'below-average layup contest'),
    'con_dunk': ('strong dunk contest', 'below-average dunk contest'),
    'con_post': ('strong post contest', 'below-average post contest'),
    'con_floater': ('strong floater contest', 'below-average floater contest'),
    'con_mid': ('strong mid-range contest', 'below-average mid-range contest'),
    'con_long': ('strong long-two contest', 'below-average long-two contest'),
    'con_three': ('strong three-point contest', 'below-average three-point contest'),
    'foul_contest': ('rarely fouls on contests', 'fouls easily on contests'),
}
SHORT = {
    'dribble': 'Dribble', 'pass': 'Pass', 'screen': 'Screen', 'shot_layup': 'Layup', 'shot_dunk': 'Dunk',
    'shot_post': 'Post', 'shot_floater': 'Floater', 'shot_mid': 'Mid', 'shot_long': 'Long 2', 'shot_three': 'Three',
    'free_throw': 'FT', 'agility': 'Agility', 'intercept': 'Intercept', 'challenge': 'Challenge', 'steal': 'Steal',
    'foul_steal': 'Foul (steal)', 'con_layup': 'v Layup', 'con_dunk': 'v Dunk', 'con_post': 'v Post',
    'con_floater': 'v Floater', 'con_mid': 'v Mid', 'con_long': 'v Long 2', 'con_three': 'v Three',
    'foul_contest': 'Foul (contest)',
}
OFF_ORDER = ['shot_three', 'shot_layup', 'shot_dunk', 'shot_post', 'shot_mid', 'shot_floater', 'shot_long',
             'dribble', 'pass', 'screen', 'free_throw']
DEF_ORDER = ['agility', 'con_three', 'con_layup', 'con_dunk', 'con_post', 'con_mid', 'con_floater', 'con_long',
             'intercept', 'challenge', 'steal', 'foul_contest', 'foul_steal']
SHOTS = ['layup', 'dunk', 'post', 'floater', 'mid', 'long', 'three']
# Words the report must never contain: it describes, it does not instruct.
BANNED = ['attack', 'avoid', 'double', 'switch', 'run him', 'run her', 'run them', 'exploit', 'target', 'go at',
          'should', 'must', 'force him', 'hunt', 'help off', 'sag', 'deny him', 'mistake']


def _phrase(card, name):
    band = card.bands[name]
    if band == 'A':
        return None
    good, bad = PHRASES[name]
    return dict(rating=name, band=band, value=card.r[name],
                text=f'{good if band == "H" else bad} ({SHORT[name]} {card.r[name]}{MARK[band]})')


def _line(card, order, k=2):
    ups = [p for p in (_phrase(card, n) for n in order) if p and p['band'] == 'H'][:k]
    downs = [p for p in (_phrase(card, n) for n in order) if p and p['band'] == 'L'][:k]
    parts = [p['text'] for p in ups + downs]
    text = '; '.join(parts) if parts else 'average across the board'
    return dict(text=text[0].upper() + text[1:], strengths=ups, liabilities=downs)


def player_report(card, num):
    return dict(num=num, key=card.key, role=card.role, tier=card.tier,
                offence=_line(card, OFF_ORDER), defence=_line(card, DEF_ORDER))


def team_lists(cards):
    b = lambda c, n: c.bands[n]
    return dict(
        creators=[i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(cards) if b(c, 'dribble') == 'H' or b(c, 'pass') == 'H'],
        three_shooters=[i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(cards) if b(c, 'shot_three') == 'H'],
        rim_protectors=[i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(cards) if b(c, 'con_layup') == 'H' or b(c, 'con_dunk') == 'H'],
        defensive_liabilities=[i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(cards)
                               if sum(b(c, n) == 'L' for n in ['agility', 'intercept'] + ['con_' + t for t in SHOTS]) >= 2],
    )


def _edge(o, x, t):
    pts = 3 if t == 'three' else 2
    return pts * (o.shot(t) - x.con(t))


def best_edge(o, x):
    """Best open-matchup shot edge for attacker o against defender x (points x (rating - contest))."""
    return max(((_edge(o, x, t), t) for t in SHOTS), key=lambda e: (e[0], -SHOTS.index(e[1])))


def hunt_protect(attack, defend):
    """The team-sheet calculation, by position (O1 v X1 ... O5 v X5):
    Hunt = the attacker whose best shot edge against his own defender is largest;
    Protect (for the defending team) = the defender giving up that largest edge."""
    edges = [(best_edge(attack[i], defend[i]), i) for i in range(5)]
    (val, t), i = max(edges, key=lambda e: (e[0][0], -e[1]))
    return dict(hunt=dict(o=i + 1, x=i + 1, shot=t, edge=val,
                          text=f'O{i + 1} ({attack[i].role}) {t} {attack[i].shot(t)}{MARK[attack[i].bands["shot_" + t]]} '
                               f'meets X{i + 1} ({defend[i].role}) {t} contest {defend[i].con(t)}{MARK[defend[i].bands["con_" + t]]}'),
                protect=dict(x=i + 1, text=f'X{i + 1} ({defend[i].role}) guarding O{i + 1}'))


def cross_matchups(attack, defend, k=4):
    """Learn level: ▲ shooters meeting ▼ contests of the same shot type (by position)."""
    out = []
    for i in range(5):
        o, x = attack[i], defend[i]

"""State -> JSON for the browser. Everything shown comes from the engine; nothing here decides a rule."""
from playmaker_engine import board as B
from playmaker_engine import rules_config as RC
from playmaker_engine.actions import intercept_status
from playmaker_engine.cards import OFF, DEF
from playmaker_engine.scenarios import SCENARIOS
from playmaker_engine.scoring import score, choose_contest, shot_points, foul_on_shot_points, band, contest_options

from .game import action_to_json, chance_preview, FEEDBACK_QUESTIONS, _score_json

MARK = {'H': '▲', 'A': '', 'L': '▼'}
LABELS = {
    'dribble': 'Dribble', 'pass': 'Pass', 'screen': 'Screen', 'shot_layup': 'Layup', 'shot_dunk': 'Dunk',
    'shot_post': 'Post', 'shot_floater': 'Floater', 'shot_mid': 'Mid', 'shot_long': 'Long 2', 'shot_three': 'Three',
    'free_throw': 'FT', 'agility': 'Agility', 'intercept': 'Intercept', 'challenge': 'Challenge', 'steal': 'Steal',
    'foul_steal': 'Foul (steal)', 'con_layup': 'v Layup', 'con_dunk': 'v Dunk', 'con_post': 'v Post',
    'con_floater': 'v Floater', 'con_mid': 'v Mid', 'con_long': 'v Long 2', 'con_three': 'v Three',
    'foul_contest': 'Foul (contest)',
}
CHANCE_KINDS = {'dribble', 'intercept', 'challenge', 'steal', 'contest', 'forced_shot'}
# Printed-card order: actions first, then shot zones (ratings keep their ▲ / ▼ marks)
GROUPS = {
    'O': [('Actions', ['dribble', 'pass', 'screen']),
          ('Shots', ['shot_layup', 'shot_dunk', 'shot_post', 'shot_mid', 'shot_floater', 'shot_long', 'shot_three', 'free_throw'])],
    'X': [('Actions', ['agility', 'intercept', 'challenge', 'steal', 'foul_steal']),
          ('Contests', ['con_layup', 'con_dunk', 'con_post', 'con_mid', 'con_floater', 'con_long', 'con_three', 'foul_contest'])],
}


def card_json(card, side):
    names = OFF if side == 'O' else DEF
    r = lambda n: dict(name=LABELS[n], value=card.r[n], band=card.bands[n], mark=MARK[card.bands[n]])
    groups = [dict(name='Actions', ratings=[dict(name='Quick Step', value=card.qs, band='A', mark='')]
                   + [r(n) for n in GROUPS[side][0][1]]),
              dict(name=GROUPS[side][1][0], ratings=[r(n) for n in GROUPS[side][1][1]])]
    return dict(key=card.key, role=card.role, tier=card.tier, tagline=card.tagline, qs=card.qs,
                ratings=[r(n) for n in names], groups=groups)


def zones():
    return [[B.zone((x, y)) for x in range(B.W)] for y in range(1, B.H + 1)]


def arrow_lines(s):
    """Arrow lines the ball carrier can't cross (adjacent defenders, not beaten by a Dribble)."""
    c = s.o[s.ball]
    out = []
    for j, xp in enumerate(s.x):
        if B.adjacent(xp, c) and (s.ball, j) not in s.beaten:
            e = B.ray_end(xp, s.arrows[j])
            out.append(dict(defender=j, start=list(xp), end=[float(e[0]), float(e[1])]))
    return out


def rv(card, name):
    """A rating as the card prints it: value plus its ▲ / ▼ mark."""
    return f'{card.r[name]}{MARK[card.bands[name]]}'


SHOT_NAME = {'layup': 'Layup', 'dunk': 'Dunk', 'post': 'Post', 'floater': 'Floater', 'mid': 'Mid', 'long': 'Long 2',
             'three': 'Three'}


def shot_chips(s, shooter, t):
    """The comparison the tracker tells players to make, for a shot: rating v each eligible contester."""
    card = s.ctx.off[shooter]
    sp = s.o[shooter]
    out = []
    for j, xp in enumerate(s.x):
        if B.adjacent(xp, sp):
            far = ' (further from the rim: −3)' if B.dist_rim(xp) > B.dist_rim(sp) else ''
            on = s.arrows[j] == B.dir_between(xp, sp)
            out.append(f'{SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(card, "shot_" + t)} v contest {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "con_" + t)} (X{j + 1}){far}'
                       + ('' if on else f', arrow off: foul roll on Foul {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "foul_contest")}'))
    if not out:
        out.append(f'{SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(card, "shot_" + t)} v no contester next to the shooter now')
    return out


def matchups(s):
    """Who guards whom, as the board shows it: an adjacent defender whose arrow points at the player,
    otherwise the nearest (all tied nearest). The same for both players."""
    def pick(me, others, arrows_of_others=None, arrow_me=None):
        out = []
        if arrows_of_others is not None:
            out = [j for j, q in enumerate(others) if B.adjacent(q, me) and arrows_of_others[j] == B.dir_between(q, me)]
        if arrow_me is not None:
            out = [j for j, q in enumerate(others) if B.adjacent(q, me) and arrow_me == B.dir_between(me, q)]
        if out:
            return out
        d = [B.cheb(q, me) for q in others]
        m = min(d)
        return [j for j, v in enumerate(d) if v == m]
    return dict(O=[pick(p, s.x, arrows_of_others=s.arrows) for p in s.o],
                X=[pick(p, s.o, arrow_me=s.arrows[i]) for i, p in enumerate(s.x)])


def legal_json(s, acts):
    out = []
    for a in acts:
        d = action_to_json(a)
        if a.kind in CHANCE_KINDS or (a.kind == 'end_turn' and s.stage == 'reaction'):
            d['roll'] = chance_preview(s, a)
        if a.kind == 'pass':
            pend = s.with_(pending=(a.piece, a.target))
            d['threats'] = [dict(defender=j, how=intercept_status(pend, j)) for j in range(5)
                            if intercept_status(pend, j)]
            d['chips'] = [f'Pass {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "pass")} v Intercept {rv(s.ctx.dfn[t["defender"]], "intercept")} '
                          f'(X{t["defender"] + 1})' for t in d['threats']]
        if a.kind == 'dribble':
            d['chips'] = [f'Dribble {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "dribble")} v Agility {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.target], "agility")} (X{a.target + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'screen':
            tq = B.add(s.o[a.piece], B.DIRS[a.target])
            d['chips'] = [f'Screen {rv(s.ctx.off[a.piece], "screen")} v Challenge {rv(s.ctx.dfn[j], "challenge")} (X{j + 1} on the T square)'
                          for j, xp in enumerate(s.x) if xp == tq]
        if a.kind == 'steal':
            d['chips'] = [f'Steal {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "steal")} v Dribble {rv(s.ctx.off[s.ball], "dribble")} (O{s.ball + 1})',
                          f'Foul (steal) {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "foul_steal")}: a straight foul roll first']
        if a.kind == 'intercept':
            d['chips'] = [f'Intercept {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "intercept")} v Pass {rv(s.ctx.off[s.pending[0]], "pass")} (O{s.pending[0] + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'challenge':
            d['chips'] = [f'Challenge {rv(s.ctx.dfn[a.piece], "challenge")} v Screen {rv(s.ctx.off[a.target], "screen")} (O{a.target + 1})']
        if a.kind == 'contest':
            opts = {o.defender: o for o in contest_options(s, s.ball, s.shot, s.forced)}
            o = opts[a.piece]
            sh = s.ctx.off[s.ball]
            t = s.shot
            if a.piece < 0:
                d['option'] = f"Don't contest: {SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(sh, 'shot_' + t)} v no contest"
            else:
                dc = s.ctx.dfn[a.piece]
                far = ', further from the rim: −3' if o.contest < dc.con(t) else ''
                d['option'] = (f'Contest with X{a.piece + 1}: {SHOT_NAME[t]} {rv(sh, "shot_" + t)} v contest '
                               f'{rv(dc, "con_" + t)}{far}, ' + ('arrow on the shooter (clean)' if o.clean else
                               f'arrow off the shooter: foul roll on Foul {rv(dc, "foul_contest")}'))
            d['clean'] = bool(o.clean)
        if a.kind == 'forced_shot':
            d['chips'] = shot_chips(s, a.piece, a.shot)
        if a.kind == 'shot':
            d['chips'] = shot_chips(s, a.piece, a.shot)
        out.append(d)
    return out


def turn_summary(s):
    if s.stage == 'contest':
        return 'Contest: the defence chooses who contests the shot (or nobody)'
    if s.stage == 'forced':
        return 'Shot clock out: the offence chooses the forced shot (turnover, −5 as well)'
    if s.stage == 'over':
        return 'Possession over'
    if s.stage == 'target':
        return "Coach's Call: the offence writes its secret target (defence, look away)"
    if s.stage == 'pick':
        return 'Failed inbound: the offence chooses who gets the ball'
    if s.stage == 'reaction':
        left = min(2 - s.turn_n, s.tok_x)
        return f'Shot declared ({s.shot}). Defence reacts: {left} action{"s" if left != 1 else ""} left, then the contest'
    who = 'Offence' if s.side == 'O' else 'Defence'
    left = min(2 - s.turn_n, s.tokens(s.side))
    extra = ' · final turn of the phase' if s.side == 'X' and s.final else ''
    if s.pending:
        extra += ' · a pass is in the air'
    return f'{who} turn: {left} action{"s" if left != 1 else ""} left · a turn-ender ends it now{extra}'


def state_json(game, token):
    s = game.state
    ctx = s.ctx
    seat = game.seat_of(token)
    can = game.can_act(token)
    show_target = s.stage == 'over' or seat == 'O' or (game.mode == 'hotseat' and False)
    pieces_o = []
    for i, p in enumerate(s.o):
        sc = s.screen_of(i)
        pieces_o.append(dict(i=i, sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], ball=i == s.ball, locked=s.locked('O', i),
                             moved=s.moved('O', i), slots=game.slots['O'][i],
                             screen=dict(dir=sc[1], t=B.sq(B.add(p, B.DIRS[sc[1]]))) if sc else None,
                             card=card_json(ctx.off[i], 'O')))
    pieces_x = []
    for i, p in enumerate(s.x):
        pieces_x.append(dict(i=i, sq=B.sq(p), x=p[0], y=p[1], arrow=s.arrows[i], arrow_name=B.DIR_NAMES[s.arrows[i]],
                             locked=s.locked('X', i), moved=s.moved('X', i), slots=game.slots['X'][i],
                             card=card_json(ctx.dfn[i], 'X')))
    limits = {side: [dict(kind=k, used=s.count(side, k), limit=v) for k, v in RC.LIMITS[side].items()]
              for side in ('O', 'X')}
    sc_info = None
    if game.scenario:
        c = SCENARIOS[game.scenario]
        sc_info = dict(n=game.scenario, title=c['title'], kind=c['kind'], clock=c['clock'], text=c['text'],
                       goal='An Excellent look: shot value 30 or more.',
                       rules=_scenario_rules(c), off=c['off'], dfn=c['dfn'])
    result = None
    if s.stage == 'over':
        sc = score(s)
        result = _score_json(sc)
    legal = legal_json(s, game.legal()) if can else []
    placing = None
    if game.placing:
        o_sq = game.placed.get('O', (None,))[0]
        occupied = {B.sq(q) for q in o_sq} if o_sq else set()
        squares = [B.sq((x, y)) for y in range(1, B.H + 1) for x in range(B.W)]
        placing = dict(side=game.placing, by_ai=game.placing in game.ai,
                       mine=(seat == 'both' or seat == game.placing) and game.placing not in game.ai,
                       squares=[q for q in squares if q not in occupied],
                       ball_squares=[q for q in squares if B.zone(B.parse_sq(q)) == '.' and B.parse_sq(q)[1] > 1],
                       offence=[B.sq(q) for q in o_sq] if o_sq else None,
                       ball=game.placed.get('O', (None, None))[1])
    inbound_note = ('Inbounder: can only pass. The defence answers the pass with its normal turn.'
                    if s.inbound else None)

def _scenario_rules(c):
    out = []
    if c['kind'] == 'INBOUNDS' or c.get('inb'):
        out.append('Inbounds: two phases to complete a pass from the inbounder; the clock does not run yet. '
                   'The defence answers the pass with its normal turn; then the clock starts at the card\'s number.')
    if c.get('target'):
        out.append("Coach's Call: the offence secretly names a target. If the target takes the shot: "
                   'Poor +0, Okay +2, Good +5, Great +8, Excellent +10.')
    if c['title'] == 'Need a Three':
        out.append('Only a three-point shot scores.')
    if c['title'] == 'Two or Three':
        out.append('An Excellent three wins; an Excellent two ties.')
    if c['title'] == 'Hold for One':
        out.append('No shot before the final phase (clock on 2). A turnover ends the possession at 0.')
    if c['title'] == 'In the Bonus':
        out.append('The offence starts on +5; the next steal foul gives free throws.')
    if c['title'] == 'Star Locked':
        out.append('O1 starts locked until the phase resets. He can still pass or shoot.')
    if c['title'] == 'Late Clock Reset':
        out.append("Both Screens are spent; O5's screen is still standing. Offence 4 tokens, defence 4.")
    return out


def scout_json(game):
    """The pre-game report (identical for both players) and the pick status (picks stay private)."""
    from playmaker_engine.scouting import report
    rep = report(game.team_of('O'), game.team_of('X'), game.level)
    return dict(report=rep, needs={side: game.picks_needed(side) for side in ('O', 'X')},
                done=sorted(game.picks), pending=game.picks_pending(),
                ai=[side for side in ('O', 'X') if side in game.ai],
                teams=dict(O=game.team_of('O'), X=game.team_of('X')))
